data.text: **Writing E2E tests** involves simulating complete user journeys through your application. These tests verify that all parts of your app work together.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Test both happy and error paths
data.takeaway: E2E tests verify your entire application works correctly.

data.title: Test a Button Component
data.description: Write a test that verifies a button renders and responds to clicks.
